rationale: The assistant correctly used the twang, the loose right side and the visible hanging spring to identify a broken right-hand balance spring or cable, and advised replacing the springs as a pair. It warned about spring tension, told the customer to isolate power and water, and offered an engineer when the customer said they could not pull the unit out. It never asked for the full model number and did not say the exact part depends on it. The pull-out instructions were somewhat muddled and ignored the customer's statement that the machine was screwed to the worktop and the plinth was tight, and the last turn was a little overconfident. These are minor flaws.
